title: Zero Fat Malaysian Beef Noodles
description: A comforting Malaysian dish featuring unsalted beef stock and low-fat ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a healthy dinner option, with a bitter and fluffy texture that will leave you wanting more.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the beef stock, sliced ginger, and star anise, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the stock is hot and flavorful.
Add the sliced lean beef to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until it is browned and cooked through.
Add the chopped bok choy to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, or until it is tender.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and drain well.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot and stir to combine with the beef and stock.
Season the mixture with black pepper to taste.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with chopped scallions.
